newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Eureko net profit increases 5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Eureko net profit increases 5 pct in 1996.

text.p: Eureko BV, holding company of the European financial services alliance Eureko, said it had increased after tax profits by five percent in 1996 to 111.6 million guilders.
"Most of the operations improved their contributions to the result, mainly benefiting from the good performance of the securities and currencies markets," Eureko said.

The contribution of partner companies increased by more than 11 percent to 65.4 million guilders. Eureko, an alliance of six companies, includes Dutch Achmea, Britain's Friends Provident, German Gothaer Versicherungen, Sweden's Wasa, Topdanmark and BCP of Portugal.
Achmea's contribution to the Eureko result was 22.1 million guilders, 57 percent more than the previous year.
Topdanmark saw its contribution come down to 9.6 million guilders, a decrease of 16 percent as Eureko had reduced its shareholding in Topdanmark.
The result from BCP Group was 49.9 million guilders. Wasa showed a slight negative contribution (-0.2 million guilders), mainly due to slightly higher expense levels.
From subsidiary companies the contribution to profits was 19.2 million guilders, two percent more than the previous year.

Eureko said it is increasing its efforts to extend the alliance, continuing discussions with potential partners and is reviewing its capacity for pursuing acquisitions to achieve its major objectives.
